A '''crest''' could be found on the banner of the [[Inrokini family]].<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref> [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] bore<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> the [[Color/Legends|yellow]] crest on the burgundy shoulder patch<ref name="TEA" /> of his [[Defense Fleet uniform|uniform]], and a black version was also displayed on the [[Chiss robes of state|robe]] of [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]], core name "Thrass," of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
